notes.title: UPDATE 1.09 - New Introduction Voiced Jokes From Nerm!
notes.content:
This update is a pretty simple update and just adds a few new things that Nerm might joke about on the introduction screen.  (The total number of possible random voiced sayings went from 20 to 25 with this update)

Note: Nothing about the core gameplay mechanics or levels has changed at all.

One important thing you might notice now is that if you try selecting "Multiplayer" from the introduction screen... a message will inform you that the "Nerm + Norma DLC" will come once this game receives 50 or more positive Steam reviews.  If you want to see Norma, Nerms female companion come to this game to assist him with local multiplayer (and Remote Play Together as well), make sure you leave a review for this game here on Steam!

Stay safe out there and be happy and well!  ..And remember that Nerm loves you!  =)

ZaxtorGameS  (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.07 - Nerm Moves 10% Faster & A Brakes Problem Has Been Fixed
notes.content:
In this update, Nerm will now start off about 10% faster than before and have a max speed about 7% faster then before.

This update also includes new code in the brakes that should prevent Nerm from sometimes speeding up after applying brakes.  His speed after applying brakes and moving again should now almost always be a little slower then before you applied the brakes.  - This assumes Nerm isn't already at his minimum speed for the level you on when you applied the brakes. 

Have fun!  =)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.06 - BRAKES BURN MORE!
notes.content:
In update 1.06 here I've fixed what I believed was causing a very rare but random lock up while playing the game forcing a hard close of the game.  This was due to the game sometimes getting stuck in an endless loop trying to find a free spot to drop a new apple.  This update should fix that but PLEASE post here or in the bugs forum if you witness the game just suddenly freezing up with no way to exit the game and requiring a hard close to exit.

I've also made using the brakes much more penalizing.  Using the brakes was never intended to be used as an easy "escape death" tool so the consequences of using the brakes now can burn up more of your worm length faster than before.

That's it for update 1.06!  ..Just a small little patch to improve the game!


- ZaxtorGameS (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.05 - Getting Nerm Drunk Is A Good Thing? ...More Steam Achievements!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882717/bbbb9694da060ee48ccc081021e5f80715161726.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

In update 1.05, Nerm just continues to slowly evolve.

- Nerm now has good reason to take a dip into alcohol seen on a few of the levels and get drunk.  First of all, more apples fall from the trees when Nerm is drunk.  This could be him seeing several images of the same apple because he is so drunk, but they are worth points and growth none-the-less!  Also while Nerm is drunk and the air is full of his drunken blur, the alcohol acts as a preservative meaning apples don't spoil as long as Nerm stays drunk!  The apples also lose their point value much slower giving you the opportunity to rack up a lot more points.. assuming you can see where you are going that is!

- It should be a little easier with this update to catch falling apples as Nerm can now catch the apples when they are still just a little in the air.

- Keyboard and mouse controls are now clearly given on the introduction screen of the game.

- 11 new Steam achievements have been added to the game for advancing to every 5th level the first time and for beating the game (level 50) the first time!   This brings the total to 35 Steam achievements and many more are coming in the near future!

As always, enjoy and have fun!  Stay safe out there as well!


-  ZaxtorGameS  (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.04 - Speedometer Added + Small Speed Changes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882717/f820b61b889e58877e653ead0e0864026ac84aeb.png[/img]

There's now a new speedometer added to the UI at the top left to show you the speed of Nerm as you move through the levels.

CHANGES MADE TO NERMS SPEED:

Before this update, Nerm would get a big speed burst when eating red or green apples that would slowly dissipate over time.  But the problem with this complex system I originally designed was that if you didn't eat a red or green apple for several seconds, Nerms speed would drop and cause his speed to feel sluggish or even like the game was lagging, even though the game wasn't really lagging at all.

With this new update, you simply gain speed for every red apple eaten.  You'll get a double gain of speed for every green apple eaten.  This  higher speed will stay until you eat another apple and will not dissipate over time to prevent the game feeling sluggish at times.

You'll now lose speed when you eat a yellow apple because after all, Nerm finds yellow apples "not so good" as they are actually starting to spoil when they are yellow.  

You'll lose even more speed should you swallow a bomb as bombs are even more disgusting to Nerm!

Of course there is a minimum and maximum speed, and the minimum and maximum speeds both slowly increase as you progress through the game and get to higher and higher levels.

I think this patch helps a lot with Nerm sometimes feeling sluggish or even "laggy" when that was never truly the case.  It was just that my system was a little too complex for the games own good and this new speed system is much simpler and hopefully will make the game feel better.

That's it for update 1.04!

More Steam achievements are coming soon.. I'm just working full time and need time to make them all and add them to the game!  Also Norma has been pushed back to "hopefully" sometime in December!  *crosses my fingers* 

Thanks for reading and/or playing Nerm the Worm!  =)
..Stay SAFE out there!


- ZaxtorGameS  (Indie Solo game developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.02 - Catch Apples As They Drop For Up To 25X Points!
notes.content:
Hello again!  As usual with fresh new games when I first launch them, updates usually come pretty quickly!  

Update 1.02 here fixes the possibility of multiple purple keys spawning due to eating several apples in a very short period (less than about a second).  That should never happen again (thanks for reporting this Xecut1ve!)

Also in this update is a brand new scoring opportunity while playing Nerm!  If you watch the apples shadows as the apples fall and catch either a green apple or a red apple and it hits Nerms head instead of the ground, you'll score 1,000 points multiplied by whatever your current streak is at.  (example:  you catch a red apple as it drops to the ground while having an 11x Streak multiplier.. this would give you a scoring bonus of 11,000 points!)

Because watching the shadows of the apples will be important if you want to catch the apples for the new scoring bonus, I've made the apple shadows much easier to see in the underground rooms made of dirt.

Also, the 200,000 point extra life has been changed to 250,000.  So now extra lives will be earned at 50k, 100k, 250k, 500k and 1 million points.  Remember that you'll only score these extra lives if you start your game at level 1.

That's it for this update, but I'm sure more updates will come in the next few days!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.01 - Right Mouse Button Pauses and UnPauses Now...
notes.content:
Hello Nerm fans!

In this small update, I added the ability to pause and unpause the game by simply pressing the right mouse button instead of needing to hit the ESC key.  This is because if you had paused your game when headed right for a wall for example, and you had to use your left hand to hit the ESC key, it might mean by the time you place your left hand back on WASD you'd be dead.  So this fix should help with that little problemo!

I also fixed an issue where changing the music slider in the Options would result in a fatal error.  That should no longer happen.

Oh, and I made Nerms status be a few different things on the Pause screen instead of just the one thing about going on strike and sipping coffee.  He'll now be described as doing 11 different things when you pause the game instead of just one.  

And I added a shadow under the words when paused so the words might be easier to read when they are written over objects like walls below them on the screen.


Enjoy everyone!  


-  ZaxtorGameS  (Solo indie game developer)
